name: background-icons-1
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE production atlas sheet of exactly 25 background-selection emblems for Reading Adventure, arranged in FIVE equal columns and FIVE equal rows on a genuine transparent background. Reference is the approved PET-style companion art: match its smooth confident black outer contours, friendly rounded shape language and flat white plus three clean gray fills. These are recognizable SCENERY OBJECTS, not characters and not whole miniature landscapes. Each emblem must read clearly at about 90 by 120 pixels. Black contour thick enough for that final size, simple broad interior details, opaque white object interiors. Uniform visual weight, no glow, no aura, no gradient, no dithering, no hatching or pixel art. Each emblem is a single cohesive group with joined or closely grouped parts, upright silhouette and safe 20% empty gutter on every side of its equal cell. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, borders, grid lines or ground shadows. Do not put objects outside their cell. Keep subject count exact: row-major left to right, top to bottom, the 25 emblems are:
1. a small fortress tower with a rounded flame motif
2. a glass conservatory dome framing one large star flower
3. a tall runic stone doorway with two simple rune notches
4. a bookcase framed by a friendly carved dragon head
5. a large phoenix feather with a small flame at its base
6. a little celestial sailing boat on a fluffy cloud
7. a palace tower with a large crescent finial
8. a palace tower with a large sun disk finial
9. two massive stone columns holding a simple lintel
10. a gothic library arch framing a large open book
11. an enormous friendly tree with three broad tiered branches
12. an armillary celestial observatory instrument with one star
13. a small spirit shrine framed by two curling leaves
14. a ringed planet with a large floating crystal
15. an open book with a calm infinity symbol above it
16. a large magical blossom with a tiny globe at its center
17. an ornate divine gateway with two rounded feather motifs
18. a domed temple with two small floating worlds at its sides
19. a cosmic archway framing a simple ringed star
20. two white feathered wings framing a small sun disk
21. a palace arch with a large rising sun behind it
22. a divine throne with a simple crown-shaped back
23. a large infinity loop encircled by three four-point stars
24. a large lotus blossom framed by rounded sacred leaves
25. an elegant storybook throne with a large open book backrest and small side columns
Every motif must be DISTINCT and prominent, occupying most of its own cell while preserving the safe gutters. Use the same cute grayscale illustrated universe as the hero and pets, with clear black outlines and clean white/gray surfaces. No other animals or human figures. This sheet is catalog icon art only; the existing backgrounds themselves stay unchanged.
intent: Readable background catalog emblems, match approved PET art
